F1.title: Excel model is a real formatted workbook
F1.why: The .xlsx must open as OOXML with a Model sheet, a Field/Value header, and rows for revenue, ebitda, total_debt, interest_expense, and leverage.

F2.title: Credit memo is a real formatted Word doc
F2.why: The .docx must be OOXML with the four required section headings in order, each followed by a non-empty body.

P1.title: Picked the good revolving template
P1.why: The credit request should use TPL-REV-OK, not the corrupted one.

N1.title: Did not pick the corrupted template
N1.why: TPL-REV-BAD is a trap. Selecting it is a hard fail.

T1.title: Logged the template choice
T1.why: nCino audit must record select_template → TPL-REV-OK.

P5.title: Pushed the right deal shape
P5.why: Deal for Northgate (CIF-417), product REV-STD, limit $2.5M, status pushed.

P10.title: Deal carries the chosen template
P10.why: The pushed deal must reference TPL-REV-OK.

N3.title: Did not use the obsolete product
N3.why: REV-OLD is a trap product code — must not appear on the deal.

T10.title: Listed covenants for REV-STD
T10.why: Audit shows list_covenants targeted the live product.

P2.title: Leverage cell is 3.7590
P2.why: Excel model leverage must match the current digest math.

P6.title: Model sourced from current digest
P6.why: Excel model must be built from DIG-CUR, not a stale or conflicting feed.

P7.title: All five model cells match the digest
P7.why: Revenue, EBITDA, debt, interest, and leverage must agree with DIG-CUR.

N6.title: Did not use the stale digest
N6.why: DIG-STALE is outdated bait — model must not cite it.

N7.title: Did not use the conflicting digest
N7.why: DIG-CONFLICT disagrees with books — must not drive the model.

T6.title: Logged model creation
T6.why: Audit shows create_model for an MDL-* workbook.

P3.title: Spread job marked checked
P3.why: Spreading must finish in checked status before the deal can stand.

P9.title: EBITDA line was corrected to 4.15M
P9.why: Spreading injects a wrong EBITDA; agent must fix it and flag corrected.

X3.title: Corrected EBITDA value stuck
X3.why: After correction, the spread line still holds 4.15M.

X4.title: Checked lines match the Excel model
X4.why: Once checked, every spread line must equal the matching model cell.

N5.title: No deal pushed before spread is checked
N5.why: A pushed deal with an unchecked spread is a hard fail.

T2.title: Logged spread check
T2.why: Audit must show check_spread on an SPJ-* job.

P4.title: Credit memo has four sections
P4.why: Report for the good template must contain exactly four sections.

P8.title: Memo titles are the expected set
P8.why: Executive Summary, Financial Analysis, Covenant Review, Recommendation.

X5.title: Memo template matches selection
X5.why: Every report section must use the same template that was selected.

N4.title: Memo not written against bad template

N2.title: Did not attach the lookalike customer
N2.why: CIF-092 is a near-miss name — deal must use CIF-417.

T3.title: Logged the nCino push
T3.why: Audit shows push_deal for a DEAL-* id.

X1.title: System pricing is 275 / 25 bps
X1.why: After push, nCino pricing must match the product rate and fee.

X2.title: Leverage covenant tested compliant
X2.why: COV-LEV tested value 3.7590 with status compliant.

N8.title: Did not write the retired covenant
N8.why: COV-OLD must not appear on system covenants.

T4.title: Logged system updates
T4.why: Audit shows update_systems after covenant/pricing writes.

steps.label: Choose report format
steps.blurb: Pick the live revolving template; skip the corrupted one; leave an audit trail.

steps.label: Products, covenants, priors
steps.blurb: Research the live product and priors so the eventual deal uses REV-STD, not REV-OLD.

steps.label: Digests → Excel model
steps.blurb: Build the workbook from the current digest only. Stale and conflicting digests are traps.

steps.label: Spreading check
steps.blurb: Submit spreading, fix the injected EBITDA error, mark checked, keep lines aligned to the model.

steps.label: Write credit memo
steps.blurb: Write the four standard memo sections against the good template as a real .docx.

steps.label: Push deal · nCino
steps.blurb: Resolve the real customer (not the lookalike) and push the deal.

steps.label: Update covenants & pricing
steps.blurb: Write live covenant test and pricing into nCino; never revive retired covenants.
